Name: Manmohan Gupta
Bio:
Manmohan Gupta is a Founder of Plaksha University. Manmohan is Co-founder of Nagarro and has evolved from being the leading technologist to being the human resources guru. He mentors Nagarro's technical managers and staff while ensuring that HR practices keep in line with Nagarro's historical DNA and ethos. He is responsible for all hiring and training of technical personnel and has been instrumental in building a world-class engineering team. Manmohan has more than 17 years of experience in software architecture, design and development.

He has extensive experience in the architecture of portal solutions, workflow systems, e-commerce platforms, e-learning solutions, business intelligence and reporting systems**.** Manmohan is also a founder-partner of the leading education firm Vidya Mandir Classes, which was acquired by Educomp Solutions in 2010. He holds a Bachelor of Electrical Engineering degree from IIT Delhi.
